name: prompt-redact
description: Replaces secrets and credentials with stable placeholders inside Claude Code before the model or the session file ever sees them — prompts, tool results and replies, plus attachments and compaction summaries where the platform lets this mod see them — and restores real values only in Edit/Write/NotebookEdit arguments. 220-rule corpus plus checksum detectors, a benign-shape allowlist, fail-closed scanning, a /redact pane and a redacted-values skill. No network, no subprocess, no model call.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Scan and redact. Off leaves everything untouched; /redact on restores it.

tier.title: Aggressiveness
tier.description: strict redacts anything suspicious, balanced is the default, precision only clear-cut secrets.

minEntropy.title: Entropy floor
minEntropy.description: Minimum Shannon entropy for the generic keyword=value detector. Lower catches more and over-redacts more.

scanBudgetMs.title: Scan budget (ms)
scanBudgetMs.description: Wall-clock ceiling for scanning one row. A row that overruns it is withheld rather than sent unscanned.

disabledRules.title: Disabled rules
disabledRules.description: Comma-separated rule ids to switch off, out of the shipped corpus (see RULES.md). Removing a noisy rule is the other half of adding one via .claude/prompt-redact.rules. /redact rule off <id> does the same for this session.

guardedDeployment.title: Behind an organization guard
guardedDeployment.description: Set when a policy mod (such as cc-plugin-sec-default) seats itself outermost and forwards prompt.attachment, prompt.compose and prompt.section past the user tier. On, this plugin does not register those three hooks: they could never run there, and Claude Code would print a skipped-hook line for each. Leave off on a machine with no guard, where they carry the opaque notice and the attachment scan.
